rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the action produces the opposite of the intended result or contrasts with what was expected.

example.english: I tried to save money, but I counterproductively bought more things.
example.traditional: 我想慳錢，反而買多咗嘢。

rows.note: Use this when you want to state explicitly that the action backfires and produces the opposite result.

example.english: I worked overtime to finish the report faster, but it counterproductively made me ill.
example.traditional: 我為咗快啲完成份報告而加班，結果適得其反，搞到自己病咗。
